description: Cancel a scheduled post before it goes out: it is removed from the calendar and will not be published (same as deleting it in the dashboard calendar). Only pending or failed posts can be cancelled; one already posting or posted returns an error (a published post cannot be taken down from Katto). Confirm with the user which post (platform, clip, time) before cancelling. Safe to retry: a second call returns 'not found'. Returns { id, status: 'cancelled', previous_status }.

scheduled_post_id.description: The scheduled post id (scheduled_post_id from katto_publish_clip, or id from katto_list_scheduled_posts).

name: katto_cancel_scheduled_post
